summary: Titled as a vitest bump, the change does two things: (1) moves @cipherstash/auth and @cipherstash/profile devDependency vitest from ^3 to the repo catalog (4.1.11), removing vitest 3 from the lockfile; (2) relaxes the CI gate that requires an @cipherstash/auth changeset, adding a `--shipped` filter that drops test/example/config paths and binding manifests whose only change is devDependencies, and diffing with --no-renames. Nothing that ships to npm changes. The main risk is the release guard now failing open for devDependency-only manifest edits, which include @napi-rs/cli, the tool that builds the shipped native binary; the consequence is a toolchain change merged without its own release, not a broken package. The filter fails closed on unreadable/added/deleted manifests and on script errors, and has new unit and workflow-shape tests (not run here).

behaviour_changes.description: The require-auth-npm-changeset workflow now pipes the changed stack-auth paths through `check-auth-npm-changeset.mjs --shipped`; PRs touching only __tests__/, examples/, vitest.config.ts, tsconfig.json of the auth package, or only devDependencies of the auth/wasm/platform manifests, no longer require an @cipherstash/auth changeset.
Changed paths are listed with --no-renames so a shipped file moved into an unshipped location is still reported by its source path.

Manifest comparison reads the base side from the PR base tip (`git show $BASE_SHA:path`) and the head side from the working tree, while the path list is computed against the merge-base (`BASE...HEAD`). Missing, added or unparseable manifests are treated as shipped (fail closed).
auth and profile test suites move from vitest 3 to vitest 4.1.11 via `catalog:repo`; vitest 3 entries are removed from pnpm-lock.yaml. Dev-only; not in either package's published files.

failure_scenarios.title: Build-toolchain devDependency bump in auth/package.json merges without an auth release
failure_scenarios.trigger: A PR changes only devDependencies of languages/typescript/packages/auth/package.json, e.g. bumping @napi-rs/cli (used by build:native) or typescript.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: UNSHIPPED_MANIFEST_FIELDS treats every devDependencies change as non-shipping, but @napi-rs/cli is a devDependency that drives `napi build`, which produces the shipped per-platform .node binaries. isShipped returns false, SHIPPED_CHANGES is empty, the workflow exits 0.
failure_scenarios.consequence: The toolchain change lands with no version bump and is picked up silently by the next unrelated auth release; a build regression it introduces surfaces only then, attributed to the wrong change. No published package changes at merge time.

existing_verification.description: Unit test asserts devDependency-only manifest edits are dropped (intended behaviour), and that version/files/peerDependencies/dependencies/exports changes are kept.

missing_verification: No rule or test distinguishing build-affecting devDependencies (@napi-rs/cli) from test-only ones (vitest).
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Decide explicitly whether @napi-rs/cli changes should require a release; if so, keep it out of the ignored set (e.g. ignore only named test devDependencies).

failure_scenarios.title: Manifest compared against base tip rather than merge-base causes spurious changeset demands
failure_scenarios.trigger: A long-lived PR touches only auth devDependencies while main has since bumped the auth version (Version Packages PR).
failure_scenarios.mechanism: gitReader reads `$BASE_SHA:path` (base tip) while the path list comes from `BASE...HEAD`; the non-dev fields differ because of main's own change, so isShipped returns true.
failure_scenarios.consequence: Fails closed: the PR is asked for an unnecessary changeset until rebased. Friction only; no unreleased change escapes.
missing_verification: No test with a base that has advanced past the merge-base.
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Read the base side at `git merge-base $BASE_SHA HEAD`, or accept the friction.

evidence.claim: CHANGED is computed with `git diff --name-only --no-renames BASE...HEAD`, filtered by `--shipped "$BASE_SHA"`; empty result exits 0 without a changeset; script failure exits 1.
NEVER_SHIPPED prefixes, UNSHIPPED_MANIFEST_FIELDS=['devDependencies'], isShipped returns true for missing/unparseable manifests, base read via `git show baseSha:path`, head via fs.
`files` excludes __tests__, examples, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts; build:native runs `napi build` from devDependency @napi-rs/cli.
vitest devDependency changed from ^3 to catalog:repo (also in auth package.json).
New tests cover isShipped drop/keep cases, the --shipped CLI against HEAD and the empty tree, and the workflow's --no-renames and --shipped wiring.
